|                                                                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                 |
| # Configuration Parameters for Flashing {#configuration-parameters-for-flashing-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                 |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

+--------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Parameter                | Possible Arguments                                                                                | Default          | Description                                                                      |
+==========================+===================================================================================================+==================+==================================================================================+
| BAUD_RATE                | •125: 125 kBaud                                                                                   | 250 kBaud        | Data Baudrate of the controller for CAN 2.0 communication.                       |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          | •250: 250 kBaud                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          | •500: 500 kBaud                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          | •1000: 1000 kBaud                                                                                 |                  |                                                                                  |
+--------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| SERVER_ID                |                                                                                                   | 0x01             | The Node ID of the RC40 to be entered.                                           |
+--------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| CLIENT_ID                |                                                                                                   | 0xFA             | The Node ID of the Service tool (0xfa).                                          |
+--------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| SELECT_BLOCK_NAME        | •CB_ASW: CB section + ASW Section + DS Section                                                    | 2                | The sections which are required to be flashed is entered                         |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          | •ASW: ASW Section and DS Section                                                                  |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          | •DS: DS Section                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          | •KEYFILE : KEYFILE Section                                                                        |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          | •CB: CB section                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
+--------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ECU_CB_PATH              |                                                                                                   | N/A              | The path to the CB software hex file that needs to be flashed to the ECUs        |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  | Example: D:\\Code\\Tool_File\\sb_cb.hex                                          |
+--------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ECU_ASW_DS_PATH          |                                                                                                   | N/A              | The path to the ASW/DS0 software hex file that needs to be flashed to the ECUs   |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  | Example: D:\\Code\\Tool_File\\appl_RC40_large.hex                                |
+--------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ECU_CRA_PATH             |                                                                                                   | N/A              | The path to the KEYFILE hex that needs to be flashed to the ECU.\                |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  | The path to UNLOCKFILE hex that needs to be flashed to the ECU.\                 |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  |  \                                                                               |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  | Example: D:\\Code\\Tool_File\\RC5-6-40-keyFile.root.hex.\                        |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  | Example for unlock file\                                                         |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  | RC5-6-40-unlockFile.20-07-13.00000042.hex                                        |
+--------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| DEBUG_LOG_PATH           |                                                                                                   | N/A              | The path to the log file where the flashing log will be saved.                   |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  | Note: The user shall create a text file and pass its path as an argument here.   |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  | Example: D:\\Code\\Tool_File\\Log_File\\DebugLog.txt                             |
+--------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| SELECT_FLASH_LOG_OPTION  | 1: A detailed log file with the flashing status along with the CAN-USB Interface Trace is saved   | 1                | The type of log file to be saved for flashing                                    |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          | 2: An optimized log file with flashing status is saved                                            |                  |                                                                                  |
+--------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| SELECT_TOOL_SERVICE_MODE | Mode of operations                                                                                | 1                | Mode of operation of the tool has to be selected here.                           |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          | •1: Flashing                                                                                      |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  |                                                                                  |
|                          |                                                                                                   |                  | Note: Currently only flashing mode is supported                                  |
+--------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| FLASH PASSWORD           |                                                                                                   | DEF_PASSWORD_021 | Password for flashing of RC40.                                                   |
+--------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
